## PM · 先更正我自己,再评审 (PR #5546)

### ⚠️ 我的 CI 分诊错了,而且错在没做一次本可以做的读取

我在诊断里写:

> **`Test (shard 2/4)` — 一条**既有** pin 与改动冲突……`sentry.test.ts:143` 期望 `Sentry.init` 收到含 `sendDefaultPii: false` 的对象……如果这是因为你正确倒置了失败方向,那么移动的是 **pin 的前提**,而非改动本身。

**`sentry.test.ts` 根本不是既有文件,它是这个 PR 自己新建的。** 我现验过,并配了控制探针:

```
$ git ls-tree --name-only origin/main -- packages/app-shell/src/observability/
packages/app-shell/src/observability/index.ts
packages/app-shell/src/observability/sentry.ts
packages/app-shell/src/observability/settleSignal.test.ts
packages/app-shell/src/observability/settleSignal.ts          <- 没有 sentry.test.ts

控制探针(必须命中,且命中):origin/main:packages/app-shell/src/observability/sentry.ts 存在
```

控制探针命中,所以那个「不存在」是真的。**我把一个新增文件说成了既有 pin**,并据此给出了一整套「先度量再改 pin」的框架。开发查出了真实原因,与我的假设无关:

> 本仓 Vitest 只在 `import.meta.env` 上暴露 `BASE_URL`/`DEV`/`MODE`/`PROD`/`SSR`,而 `vi.stubEnv` 写的是 `process.env`,**够不到 `import.meta.env`** —— 于是靠 stub 环境变量的初稿**实际上什么都没测**,只测到了 no-DSN 分支;这也正是它那三条「缺失」用例会「通过」的原因。

修法也比我暗示的更好:**把决策变成可达的**(抽出纯函数 `resolveSentryGate(env)`),而不是放松断言。

**形状与我本轮反复记录的那个一模一样**:我用「看起来对的东西」代替了一次读取——一个文件名 + 一个行号看着就像既有 pin,而 `git ls-tree` 一条命令就能证伪。本轮我已在 #5040、#5504、#5498、#5513 上各栽过一次同族的跟头,这是第五次。已补进座位贴。

**但那条指令本身没白给**:我要求它「先度量那条 pin 的主语,再决定动谁,不许直接删覆盖」。它照做了,于是查出了 `import.meta.env` 那条真因。**没有任何既有覆盖被删除或削弱**——这一点我也现验了(main 上那个目录本来就只有四个文件)。

### 评审(shard 2/4 仍在跑,故为部分验收)

三点差异确认**恰好 5 个文件**,全在声明面内:`packages/app-shell/src/observability/**` + `apps/console/.env.production` + changeset。**未触碰任何被占文件**。

**`fs.deny` 没有被放宽** —— 这是我诊断里最强的一条禁令,它守住了。棘轮测试改用 `node:fs` 的 `readFileSync`,并且落在 app-shell 而非 apps/console,理由是实测出来的:console 的 tsconfig 是 browser-only(`types` 不含 `node`),而 app-shell 的带 `["node", "vite/client"]`。它还说明了自己先把测试放在 `apps/console/src/__tests__/` 又移走、以及考虑过 `scripts/check-*.mjs` 但判定那是向 lint 工作流的无谓扩面——**主动收窄而不是主动扩面**,记一笔。

失败方向:DSN 缺失/空串/全空白/非字符串,以及 env 对象为 null/undefined,**全部**在动态 import **之前**返回 `enabled:false`,所以 `vendor-sentry` chunk 连取都不会取。每一个否决判决还都带 `sendDefaultPii:false`——它自己的话:「没有哪个 disabled 分支离泄漏只差一次重构」。`sendDefaultPii` 由 opt-out 改为 opt-in,并把全部近似拼写(`'TRUE'`/`'True'`/`'1'`/`'yes'`/`'on'`/`''`)逐个钉死为**不得启用**。

计数器探针用对了地方:验收条件是**缺席**(没有信封发出),而缺席正是坏测试能完美复现的形状。它用「注入 DSN 的真实构建仍然内联 6 处、仍然产出 vendor-sentry chunk」证明零值是**门**而不是**没接上的构建**;棘轮测试则自带真空守卫(先断言真的找到了文件、真的解析出了赋值)。

### 你的两个待决问题,我的裁定

**Q1 —— 选 A。** #5546 合并后 **#5522 保持 open**,由 objectstack#10741 承接剩余部分。PR 写的是 `Part of` 不是 `Fixes`,不会自动关。理由采纳你的:B 高估了已落地的范围——已发布产物现在不带任何端点了,但**已选入的构建仍然没有构建后开关**,而那正是卡面 invariant 的字面措辞;C 把一个 p0 止血压在跨仓契约变更后面。你在提议扩面之前先把 `/api/v1/runtime/config` 现有 payload 逐键读了一遍、并指出 `cloudUrl` 空串对托管 SaaS 同样成立因而不能反推 air-gapped——**这正是 `isMarketplaceEnabled()` 文档里警告的反模式**,你没有踩。

**Q2 —— 归维护者,已升级,不阻塞合并。** 设置 Vercel 环境变量在部署面板里,不在本仓,任何 agent 都做不到。已随本轮报告呈报。你把它立成 #5550 是对的处理。需要维护者知道的行为变化:`VITE_SENTRY_SEND_DEFAULT_PII` 由 **opt-out 变 opt-in**,所以托管构建即使注入了 DSN,**不显式设置就不再附带 IP/User-Agent**。

### 入队条件

`Test (shard 2/4)` 仍 `in_progress`,其余 21 个 gate 全绿。我不会在它按名读到 `completed: success` 之前入队——本轮我在 #5498 上立过这条规矩,不因为这张卡是 p0 就松。

另两个发现 **#5551**(错误追踪文档描述了一个不存在的 `src/lib/sentry.ts`,并指导第二个未脱敏的并行 init,还声称「默认 CSP 已包含 sentry.io」而 console 根本不发 CSP)与 **#5552**(vendor-sentry chunk 475,725 B / 130,935 B brotli 被打进**每一个**构建,包括门会提前返回的 no-DSN 构建,即可证的死重)已收讫,不夹带是对的——尤其 #5551,它明说修复是判断驱动的重写而非机械替换,所以不适用就地例外。

## PM · Landing recorded, and the upstream fork now exists

**PR #5559 MERGED 2026-08-21T11:35:19Z** (head `f751c0288`, 5 files). The prior seat session (`session_014zHsbJoTkTZeJQ5DLbRXrE`) reviewed this card and went dark at 10:43Z, before the merge, so nothing recorded the landing.

Verified against the merged diff rather than the report: `apps/console/.env.production` no longer defines `VITE_SENTRY_DSN` / `VITE_SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT` / `VITE_SENTRY_SEND_DEFAULT_PII`; `sendDefaultPii` moved from opt-out (`!== 'false'`) to opt-in (`=== 'true'`) with every near-miss spelling pinned off; the decision was extracted to a pure `resolveSentryGate` that fails closed on absent/empty/whitespace/non-string DSN and on a missing env object; and `committed-telemetry-endpoint.test.ts` is a ratchet over **all** committed `.env*` files that also carries vacuum guards and a counter-probe, so it cannot pass by finding nothing.

### ⚠️ `objectstack#10741` never existed — the p0 remainder had no home

The prior seat's review ruled Q1 as "this card stays open, `objectstack#10741` carries the remainder". **There is no such issue.** `issue_read` 404s on it while a control probe in the same repo succeeds (`objectstack#10803`), and `issue_read` is confirmed able to read PRs as well as issues, so "it is a PR number" does not explain it.

This mattered more than a bookkeeping slip: the remainder is the **p0 security** half — an opted-in build still has no post-build off switch — and it was pointed at a card that does not exist. It would have been dropped silently.

Worse, the merged code now says so in `packages/app-shell/src/observability/sentry.ts`:

> ⚠️ Known limitation … a telemetry key on that payload is an objectstack contract change, not objectui's to make. **Filed upstream; see the issue for the fork.**

That sentence shipped to `main` pointing at nothing.

### Fork filed: `objectstack-ai/objectstack#10805`

Duplicate-checked first (keyword sweep of objectstack for Sentry / telemetry / runtime-config / DSN returned nothing). It carries the cloud#1508 measurement, the reason the seam has to be `/api/v1/runtime/config`, the fail-closed requirement, and the verbatim module comment that names the fork. Filed unassigned and ungraded so the triage seat produces its `domain:*` and grading — this seat does not produce routing labels.

### State — deliberately not changed by this seat

This card carries assignee `qq9340100`, which is not this seat, and no `Claim:` comment identifies whose it is. Under "assignee is not you ⇒ claimed, never touch" I have **not** altered its labels or assignee, so it stays `pm:dispatched`. That is not the honest end state — with #5559 merged it should read `pm:blocked` with `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#10805`, the consumer half being "read the runtime telemetry key and gate `initSentry` on it".

Flagged in this round's report rather than resolved here. Whoever holds the claim, or the maintainer, should make that transition; a `pm:dispatched` card is at least not re-dispatchable in the meantime, so nothing will double-book it.

> That is not the honest end state — with #5559 merged it should read `pm:blocked` with `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#10805`, the consumer half being "read the runtime telemetry key and gate `initSentry` on it".

现在按那条自述执行 —— 本卡当前 assignee 为空，且这是维护者指令下的清账，不是第二个人去抢一张有主的卡。

剩余物是 **p0 安全半边**：已 opt-in 的构建仍没有构建后的关闭开关，需要 objectstack 侧 `/api/v1/runtime/config` 的遥测键先落地（#10805）。已落地的那半（`.env.production` 不再带 DSN、`sendDefaultPii` 从 opt-out 改 opt-in、`resolveSentryGate` 失败即关闭、`committed-telemetry-endpoint.test.ts` 棘轮）不受影响。

本笔是维护者指令下的 H8 清账（2026-08-22，session `session_014kugUSM5M5fJBsk1f8KdtN`）：只做合并的配对写入，⛔ 未改卡面范围、未动 assignee。

## Reclaimed — dispatch died before producing anything, card returns to the queue

The R34 dev on this card **terminated on a server-side API error (529 Overloaded)**, which is an ordinary subagent death, not a maintainer abort and not a defect in the card.

**Verdict taken from positive evidence on GitHub, not from the death notice** — the check that matters, because a dead agent's exit string is not a report:

| probe | reading |
|---|---|
| new remote branch | **none** — `claude/issue-5522-runtime-telemetry-gate` resolves to `baac3f46e`, which is an existing `main` commit (#5946), i.e. a stale ref carrying no work |
| the branch named in the claim | `claude/issue-5522-sentry-disableable-telemetry` is the **pre-existing** branch from 2026-08-21 (`e94b85847`, `f751c0288`) — three days old, unchanged by this dispatch |
| pull request | **none opened** |
| `<!-- os-dev-report -->` on this card | **none** |

Zero artefacts, so there is nothing to salvage and nothing to review. Assignee cleared, `pm:dispatched` → `pm:queue`, and the card is dispatchable again exactly as it was.

⚠️ **Carry forward to whoever takes it next** — the one piece of state this round did establish, so it is not re-derived:

**The pre-existing branch `claude/issue-5522-sentry-disableable-telemetry` is real work from an earlier attempt**, not an empty ref. Its two commits are *"console/app-shell: stop committing a live Sentry DSN into the published bundle"* and *"app-shell: extract `resolveSentryGate` as the testable decision seam"*, both dated 2026-08-21, based on a `main` that is now three days stale. **Read it before starting** and state explicitly whether you are continuing it or replacing it — ⛔ do not silently open a second lineage on the same card.

The standing constraints on this card are unchanged: ⛔ do not invent a replacement DSN (rotating a committed credential is a maintainer action, to be named in the report rather than improvised), and deleting the value is not sufficient if a shipped bundle can still emit — the deliverable is that a shipped build can be silenced.

## ⛔ Read this before you read the card: the card's own title is now out of date

**The objectui half of this card is already fixed and merged** — PR #5559, 2026-08-21. The prior seat's note that this card's branch "carries real work, declare continue-or-replace" is **wrong in the half that matters**: the two commits on `claude/issue-5522-sentry-disableable-telemetry` (`e94b85847`, `f751c0288`) *are* PR #5559. That branch is **spent**. ⛔ Do not continue it, and ⛔ do not touch `claude/issue-5522-runtime-telemetry-gate` either — it resolves to an ordinary `main` commit and carries nothing. Start fresh from current `main` on the branch named above.

Verified by me on `origin/main`, not relayed:

- `apps/console/.env.production` commits **no DSN** and now carries a long comment explaining why one must never be committed.
- `resolveSentryGate` exists as a pure function (`sentry.ts:91`), fails closed on absent/empty/whitespace/non-string DSN and on a null env.
- `sendDefaultPii` is **opt-in** (`env?.VITE_SENTRY_SEND_DEFAULT_PII === 'true'`, `sentry.ts:114`).
- `committed-telemetry-endpoint.test.ts` is the ratchet over committed `.env*` files.

## Adjudication (not re-litigable): scope is the consumer half only

This is the remainder named verbatim in the merged module comment at `sentry.ts:34-36`:

> ⚠️ Known limitation, deliberately not worked around here: a build that DID opt in still has no post-build off switch, because the only server→SPA channel is `/api/v1/runtime/config` and a telemetry key on that payload is an objectstack contract change, not objectui's to make. Filed upstream; see the issue for the fork.

**That upstream fork has landed.** objectstack#10805 closed 2026-08-23T16:57Z via merged PR **objectstack#11382**, *"cloud-connection: serve a fail-closed SPA telemetry permission on `/api/v1/runtime/config`"*. Triage released this card at 01:37Z with: *"P0-family security … ui seat, treat as front-of-lane."*

So the deliverable is: **read that permission off the runtime config and gate `initSentry` on it, fail-closed.** The invariant, unchanged from the card: *a deployment posture must be able to hard-disable client telemetry on an already-built artifact, without rebuilding and without editing files inside a published SPA.*

## PM mechanism assumptions — measure these, and falsifying either is a good run

1. **Pin lag is the live risk.** I have verified that objectstack PR #11382 merged; I have **not** verified that the objectui pin resolves to a version whose types/payload carry the new key. Check this first. If the pin does not carry it, say so — do not invent the key's spelling from the upstream PR title, and do not bump the pin as a rider.
2. **I have not located this repo's runtime-config reader.** `branding.stage` is the precedent the card names for a server value reaching the SPA; find the actual seam rather than trusting that sentence.
3. **Fail-closed direction, from the upstream card:** a runtime that declines telemetry must beat a DSN injected at build time; absent key or failed fetch must read as *do not send*. If your measurement says the existing gate ordering makes that awkward, report the fork rather than picking a direction.

`premise_still_valid: false` with no PR is a legitimate delivery here and will be read as a good run, not a failure.

## Standing constraints, unchanged

⛔ **Do not invent or rotate a DSN.** Rotating a committed credential is a maintainer action — name it in the report rather than improvising. ⛔ Deleting a value is not sufficient if a shipped bundle can still emit.

Run `packages/app-shell` tests **path-filtered** — the whole-package suite is ~784 s and holds the shared verify lock.
